show.description:
Karthik, broken by failed investments, finds a magical phone that answers any question and suddenly becomes rich again.
But the phone comes with a rule — every time he hurts someone, its battery drains, warning him about karma.
His rise angers Roshan, the man responsible for his earlier downfall and now obsessed with Karthik’s pregnant wife, Nitya.
Their ego clash spirals until Karthik loses his baby and realizes the heavy price of greed, shortcuts, and misusing power.
